In the normal phase, the gap vanishes; we introduce the corresponding
normal-state shorthand
\begin{equation}
\Delta \equiv 0 .
\label{eq:normal-gap}
\end{equation}
In the superconducting phase the gap is nonzero.  The claimed cancellation
is
\begin{equation}
\Delta^2 + E^2 = E^2 .
\label{eq:superconducting-cancellation}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
